# Pull request

## What changed?

Describe the smallest coherent change and the affected part(s) or repository area.

## Why?

Explain the bug, learning need, recovery evidence, or maintenance reason.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] I ran the affected project's `npm run demo` when behavior changed
- [ ] New behavior has regression coverage where practical
- [ ] No paid PDF/DOCX/EPUB, answer-key package, master manuscript, or commercial publication bundle was added
- [ ] Any historical-project provenance claim is documented accurately
- [ ] Public-facing documentation keeps the official Gumroad storefront visible where relevant

## Security / compatibility

- [ ] No secret, credential, token, private key, or customer data is included
- [ ] Node.js 20 compatibility is preserved
- [ ] The MIT code license / proprietary book boundary remains clear
